text:
Predicates:
Mammal(x) ::: x is a mammal.
HasTeeth(x) ::: x has teeth.
Platypus(x) ::: x is a platypus.
Human(x) ::: x is a human.
Premises:
Some mammals have teeth ::: ∃x (Mammal(x) ∧ HasTeeth(x))
Platypus have no teeth ::: ∀x (Platypus(x) → ¬HasTeeth(x))
Platypus are mammals ::: ∀x (Platypus(x) → Mammal(x))
Humans have teeth ::: ∀x (Human(x) → HasTeeth(x))
Conclusion:
Humans are mammals ::: ∀x (Human(x) → Mammal(x))
